$comment: Integrity pins for vendored third-party code. verify-vendor.mjs (run in CI, see .github/workflows/pr.yml) recomputes each file's SHA-256 and FAILS the build on any mismatch — so a tampered or drifted parser can never ship unnoticed. sha256 is computed over LF-NORMALIZED bytes, so it is immune to CRLF-vs-LF checkout differences across platforms and equals the hash of the upstream npm artifact. To re-vendor: download the pinned upstream artifact, confirm its dist file's LF-normalized SHA-256 here, then update version + sha256 together.
